name: Toasted Naan with Smoked Salmon-Goat Cheese Spread & Chopped Salad

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ lemons
1 small bunch fresh dill
1 small bunch green onions (scallions)
1 ½ English cucumbers
1 ½ bunches radish
1 ½ small pkgs grape tomatoes

instructions.primary_message: Zest lemons into a medium bowl, then juice them into a large bowl.
Using a knife, shave dill leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add half of the dill to each bowl.
Chop salmon into ¼-inch pieces and add to the medium bowl with the lemon zest.
Crumble goat cheese into the bowl with the salmon. Add yogurt and crushed red pepper; mash with a fork to combine the spread and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ (113 g) logs goat cheese
¾ cup plain Greek yogurt
3 pinch crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Divide naan between two baking sheet pans. Place in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, flipping halfway through, until crispy, 10-12 minutes. Remove from the oven.
Meanwhile, peel and mince garlic. Add to the large bowl with the lemon juice, along with oil, maple syrup, salt, and pepper. Whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cloves garlic
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tbsp pure maple syrup
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Trim green onions; cut crosswise into ¼-inch pieces and add to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim and medium dice the cucumbers; add to the bowl.
Trim off and discard tops and root ends of radishes; thinly slice and add to the bowl.
Halve tomatoes and add to the bowl. Toss to combine the salad.
Divide salmon-goat cheese spread between toasted naan and smooth out in an even layer. Cut into quarters.
To serve, divide naan and salad between plates. Enjoy!
